verdicts.evidence: NOT YET INSTRUCTED: filed as a hole because no measurement has decided it (the isRegularFile precedent). In mutation-ratchet.yml run 42807539562 (mode=measure, this module alone) on branch chore/mutation-register-2026-11-10 at commit 7d1846b (main at 5a9cdf0, after #496, with the register and one test file changed), merged report sha256 9a04fdb4432a389dd3c5153c1bf42af0142d921e9480fcaf9873719a644214b8, Stryker reported it Killed, but the only failing test was test/unit/example-packed.test.js, whose `tar -xzf` refused the tarball npm packed inside Stryker's sandbox (members under package/../../node_modules): a failure that does not depend on the mutant, and that test failed the same way for every mutant of the run that executed it. Every other covering test passed in that leg. Re-run alone on 2026-11-13 on a local build byte-identical to the measured source (node --test test/unit/example-packed.test.js, bound 300 s against about 2 s on the pristine build), that test passes under the mutant: the unit suite does not kill it. It is not among the survivors of the module's filing before that run (run 39947132062, measured 2026-10-23). Pass 2 (the whole net) has NOT been run on it and no probe mission has applied it, so this filing claims only that the unit suite does not kill it: it is neither a measured defect nor a measured equivalence. Filed by the 0.47.0 release preparation.
